study.question: Does buy-to-context transfer through the product query account for more of the click benefit than transfer through the additive residual adapter, and does that attribution depend on the buy summary VJP?
study.hypothesis: In the current block-compressed task-conditioned model, buy transfer through the product query is more useful for click ranking than transfer through the residual adapter. Product-only transfer should retain most of the live-versus-isolated click gain and outperform residual-only transfer under both native and restored summary rules. This is an attribution/possible simplification hypothesis; the tiny restored-versus-native incumbent gap is not established as useful. Earlier all-auxiliary branch evidence motivates, but cannot establish, a buy-only claim after subsequent model changes.

nearest_work.difference: Existing same-capacity all-auxiliary branch stop-gradient contrast gave click AUC0.6684156159937658 versus0.6676246607842132, with an earlier aggregate-history model. This proposal reuses the intervention idea, restricts it to buy, and crosses branch ownership with two summary-backward rules in the current block model. It is a scoped follow-up, not a novel branch-gating method.

Both sources detach the common buy-context input before both adapters and produced identical click AUC0.6680376118468522. Here split that single input edge into two equal-valued uses, then detach exactly one. Preserve live/isolated overrides for common-state endpoint checks.

At a fixed summary rule private buy gradients should match across branch routes before dense clipping; context-edge gradients should follow gates. Runtime still must be measured.
falsifiers: If product-only fails to exceed residual-only in either rule, or retains less than80% of the live-minus-isolated benefit, the proposed general product-dominance/preservation hypothesis is unsupported for this implementation. Report the actual conditional effects, including opposite or rule-specific patterns.

If both single-edge cells underperform both-live, useful complementarity between routes remains possible; do not recommend pruning either from this evidence. If a route beats the incumbent only in one fixed seed, it remains preliminary.

If D_P and D_R are negligible, negative or inconsistent with an apparent D_B, no localized benefit of the inherited summary surrogate is established; do not treat the tiny best observed score as a mechanism.
